meta.pageSubtitle: Diagnostic performance of point-of-care formate testing against formal laboratory formate assay.

interpretation.clinicalMeaning: Normal formate level. Re-test if ethanol co-ingestion may delay methanol metabolism.
Slightly elevated formate level, typically early-stage or smaller exposure. Re-test after 2 hours.
Moderately elevated formate level. Patients may be symptomatic or soon become symptomatic.
Strongly elevated formate level. Immediate specific treatment is usually required.

config.thresholdRule: Lab ≥2.00 mmol/L is positive; lab <2.00 mmol/L is negative. POC low, moderate/medium, or high positive is positive.
